results.question: According to the Lassa fever therapeutics paper, how many confirmed Lassa fever cases were reported in Nigeria in 2023, and what was the case-fatality ratio?
results.answer: The Lassa fever therapeutics paper reports that, for Nigeria in 2023, **1,067 confirmed Lassa fever cases** were recorded and **189 of those patients died**, giving a **case‑fatality ratio (CFR) of 18 %**【7ac49b255a35cc01†document_id=24-0251†heading_path=(preamble)】.
results.ground_truth: 1,067 confirmed cases were reported in Nigeria in 2023, resulting in 189 deaths, for a case-fatality ratio (CFR) of 18%.

results.question: What is the NCT ID of the Kisumu Combined Ring Study on intravaginal rings?
results.answer: The Kisumu Combined Ring Study (KCRS) is registered in ClinicalTrials.gov under **NCT 03762382**【linkage_lookup】.

results.question: How many women participated in the qualitative interviews of the Kisumu Combined Ring Study, and what was their age range?
results.answer:
The Kisumu Combined Ring Study enrolled **25 women** who completed the one‑time, individual qualitative interview — the interview sample was 25 out of the 27 trial enrollees who consented to be interviewed【id":"598263040fc1a307】.  

The participants’ ages spanned **18 years to 34 years** (mean 21.9 years)【id":"598263040fc1a307】.  

So, 25 women took part in the qualitative interviews, and their age range was 18‑34 years.
results.ground_truth: 25 cisgender women aged 18 to 34 years participated in the qualitative interviews.

results.question: In the OCD rTMS study, how many patients participated and which brain region did the stimulation target?
results.answer: The open‑label rTMS trial in obsessive‑compulsive disorder enrolled **10 patients** and delivered low‑frequency (1 Hz) stimulation to the **pre‑supplementary motor area (pre‑SMA)**【39db42a64ee80999】.
results.ground_truth: 18 OCD patients participated, and low-frequency rTMS targeted the supplementary motor area (SMA).
